# Anshul Rana - SEO, AEO & GEO Expert

> Anshul Rana is a Top Rated Plus SEO Expert on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score. He specializes in Technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for businesses in the US, UK, Australia, and India.

## About

Anshul Rana is an engineer turned digital marketer with 8+ years of hands-on SEO experience. He has optimized and ranked over 1,000 websites across competitive industries including healthcare, real estate, SaaS, education, hospitality, and local services. He is the founder of The Digital Geek, a digital marketing agency based in Punjab, India.

Anshul holds the Top Rated Plus badge on Upwork (top 3% of freelancers), a 100% Job Success Score, and a 5.0 client rating across 50+ completed projects. He is certified in Google Digital Marketing, Google Analytics, and Google Display Ads.

## Core Expertise

- Technical SEO: Site audits, Core Web Vitals, crawl optimization, schema markup, site architecture, migrations
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): Optimizing content and structured data so brands get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Bing Copilot
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Future-proofing digital presence for AI-generated search results
- Local SEO: Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, review strategy, map pack dominance
- On-Page SEO: Title tags, meta descriptions, internal linking, header structures, content optimization
- Content Strategy: Keyword research, blog cluster planning, content calendars, writer briefs
- Reddit Marketing: Strategic subreddit targeting, brand mention campaigns, community engagement
- Quora Marketing: Niche-specific answers for brand visibility and trust signals
- GoHighLevel: CRM setup, automation workflows, virtual assistant services
